row.body:
Friday: I mended three work shirts from the seed trial. White powder shook from every cuff; my hands blistered before anyone closed the road.

The clerk wanted a cleaner version. I kept the stained one because it showed which part had been changed after the road closed.

There may be a simple reason for the change. Nobody at the next stop could tell us what to do with the first version.

row.body:
The woman brought in a coat with its pocket torn. While I pinned it, a folded list fell out. She asked me to sew the pocket closed with the list inside.

She said her brother would need the coat if he returned. I offered to write his name on the label. She shook her head so hard she dropped the thread.

I used a different color along the seam. If he comes back, someone can find the paper without ruining the whole coat.
row.title: A sleeve sewn shut
